channel.title: Hartford Business Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hartford Business Journal (hartfordbusiness.com)

item.title: 🔒 East Windsor budget hotel sells for $4.29M
item.description: A 111-room budget hotel in East Windsor has sold for $4.29 million.

item.title: Bipartisan effort seeks to boost CT tourism funding
item.description: Three bills introduced in the state’s 2026 legislative session — two by Democrats and one by a Republican — have the same goal: Significantly increase financial support for the state’s Tourism Fund.

item.title: 🔒 Neil’s Donuts eyes Wethersfield location
item.description: Neil’s Donuts, a popular New York-style bakery with locations in Wallingford and Middletown, is proposing a new quick-service restaurant in Wethersfield.

item.title: 🔒 Proposal to build nine-building commercial park in Glastonbury gains approval
item.description: Glastonbury’s Town Plan and Zoning Commission has unanimously approved a developer’s proposal to build a nine-building commercial park on Sequin Drive.

item.title: 🔒 CT legislature considers bills to create trade commissions with Germany, India
item.description: For the third year in a row, the state legislature is considering bills to establish international trade commissions, this time with both Germany and India.

item.title: 🔒 Darien investment manager sentenced in fraud case
item.description: John Masanotti Jr., 71, who now lives in Bonita Springs, Florida, was the owner and managing member of Middlesex Mortgage Group.

item.title: UConn grads report higher starting pay, strong placement rate
item.description: Recent UConn graduates are reporting high employment and education placement rates and rising starting salaries, according to a school survey.

item.title: House Republicans push to strip public benefits charge from electric bills
item.description: A trio of bills introduced by House Republicans would remove the combined public benefits charge from Connecticut electric bills and shift its roughly $1 billion annual cost to the state’s general fund.

item.title: 🔒 Portland, Maine-based marina operator buys Old Lyme Marina, neighboring property for $3M

item.title: 🔒 Branford schools to get fully electric bus fleet
item.description: Branford Public Schools’ buses will become fully electric after striking a deal with student transportation company Zūm, which will deploy an all-electric fleet beginning in the 2026-27 school year, the company announced.
